title: A. Ntarsis' Set
statement:
Ntarsis has been given a set S, initially containing integers 1, 2, 3, …, 10^1000 in sorted order. Every day, he will remove the a_1-th, a_2-th, …, a_n-th smallest numbers in S simultaneously.

What is the smallest element in S after k days?

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^5). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case consists of two integers n and k (1 ≤ n,k ≤ 2·10^5) — the length of a and the number of days.

The following line of each test case consists of n integers a_1, a_2, …, a_n (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9) — the elements of array a.

It is guaranteed that:

For each test case, print an integer that is the smallest element in S after k days.

For the first test case, each day the 1-st, 2-nd, 4-th, 5-th, and 6-th smallest elements need to be removed from S. So after the first day, S will become requirecancel {cancel 1, cancel 2, 3, cancel 4, cancel 5, cancel 6, 7, 8, 9, …} = {3, 7, 8, 9, …}. The smallest element is 3.

For the second case, each day the 1-st, 3-rd, 5-th, 6-th and 7-th smallest elements need to be removed from S. S will be changed as follows:

The smallest element left after k = 3 days is 9.

```
75 11 2 4 5 65 31 3 5 6 74 10002 3 4 59 14341 4 7 9 12 15 17 18 2010 41 3 5 7 9 11 13 15 17 1910 61 4 7 10 13 16 19 22 25 2810 1500001 3 4 5 10 11 12 13 14 15
```

Output:

1
